{{Quote|Nobody's going to put me on trial!|Mag Doum|<ref name="live" />}}
'''Mag Doum''' was a businessman and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arda II]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Doum operated a lucrative business selling [[T-6 diodem]]s pulled from discarded home service machines to the Empire at an enormous markup&mdash;as the diodems were also used in [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] could use them to lock onto Rebel targets, giving them a distinct advantage in combat. When Rebel leaders [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited Arda II to meet with the device's manufacturers over the issue, Doum ordered [[Kiros Zorad]]&mdash;a local man heavily indebted to Doum&mdash;to kidnap and dispose of Organa. Doum later lent his personal [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] to Organa's friend [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in order to deflect suspicion about his involvement, only for Organa to return alive with Zorad and publicly accuse him, leading to a near-riot. Doum narrowly managed to escape to his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], only for the vengeful Zorad to stow away on his vessel and attack him as he attempted to contact the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Doum's message did draw Vader to Arda II, but the spy was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the ensuing [[Attack on Arda II|battle]] when Zorad made a suicide run on Vader's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="live" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mag Doum appeared as a primary antagonist in the [[Star Wars (comic strip)|comic strip]] story arc ''[[As Long As We Live...]]'', written by [[Don Christensen]] and released in [[1980]]. In the comic, Doum was illustrated by [[Russ Manning]].<ref name="live" />
